name: Original palace — source-compatible angled wing modules
family: Base, wall bodies and stepped wings
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "PAL-WING-001 — Original palace — source-compatible angled wing modules". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Reserved wing reference was unproduced; provide source-matched continuous/chamfered wing segments without redesigning tower placement

PAL-WING-001-S01 — Continuous tall window wing bay. Dimensions W,D,H [60, 35, 100]m proposed. Deep joinable wing portion preserving original tall pointed glazed facade, clustered pilasters, rose/ivory marble and gold bands; rear depth extended conservatively with planar joins, flat roof terrace. Windows proportional to source; do not replace with isolated generic square blocks.

PAL-WING-001-S02 — Angled protruding wing bay. Dimensions W,D,H [55, 45, 70]m proposed. Semi-hexagonal/chamfered source-style protrusion with continuous window wall and flat usable roof; soft bevels, not sharp box. Side faces attach to neighbouring wing, roof gardens optional separate.

PAL-WING-001-S03 — Rounded pavilion wing attachment. Dimensions W,D,H [45, 45, 70]m proposed. Rounded/extruded lower pavilion host attached continuously to an adjoining wing, source pointed windows and curved terrace cornice; no extra whole dome/tower duplicated on top.

PAL-WING-001-S04 — Rear wing and terrace connector. Dimensions W,D,H [60, 75, 70]m proposed. Deep connecting wing section with two open side threshold apertures, same window and cornice language, usable roof and consistent joining planes. Back geometry proposed, front source proportions fixed.
S01 is a100m-high L2wing host. Other70m-high modules suit upper wings. Keep these portions continuous where they meet; no detached row of little boxes. Reference metre values are proposed design-grid units; final assembly multiplier and aperture contacts are not locked.
CRITICAL SOURCE TRACE: wing facade is SOLID rose marble between large blue/lilac/pink GLASS pointed window bays with gold tracery, ivory clustered piers, rose scrollspandrels, repeated ornate cornice and roof parapet. Show installed source-compatible glazing/trim for appearance, with glass/decor separable in future model. Do NOT render all bays as empty open colonnades. Only real door thresholds are open. Never add a whole extra dome or tower to the four wing portions. S01one huge glazed front bay; S02chamfered outer corner with several smaller windows; S03rounded attached glazed pavilion wall; S04deep rear connector with smaller side windows and real doorway. Old rejected variants were reviewed; this is the missing construction view, not another whole-wing scene.
